name: [🔫FFA] Deagle Duels
desc:
Welcome to Deagle Duels, A fast paced first-person shooter where the first to 5 wins, challenge players in 1v1s up to 4v4s.

🆚 Step on a pad to begin a duel. First to 5 wins.
💎 Earn Diamonds to unlock new deagle skins!
🔥 Build Huge Streaks by always winning duels!
🏆 Grind wins and earn your spot on the leaderboard!

👍 Leave a like if you enjoy the game, it supports us a lot!
🎮 Available on ALL Platforms!

🚨 Cheaters will be permanently banned. We do not give second chances.

scripts.title: Peak x | [KNIVES]
scripts.features:
🔥SCRIPT FUNCTIONS:
✅ Aim Silent — Depends on how much smooth you set

✅ Auto Shoot — Activates a FOV that detects the enemy. Depends on FOV size and Target Part

✅ Visual — ESP (mostly unstable) with color picker and transparency (0/1)

✅ Hub Data — Saves your config up to the exact Hub position

❌ The ESP may fail for some rounds or the entire match. It's a game issue, currently being fixed

📝 HOW TO USE:
1. Execute the script

2. Important wait 10 sg

3. Enable Auto Shoot or Aim Silent

4. Configure the Hub for Mobile or PC

4. Start playing and try to act normal

Script v: 1.0.8
